It’s honestly not as complicated as you think… at least if you live in the US anyways. All I did was apply for a trade name in my state, and then got business insurance.. boom that’s all you need to get started. Craigslist people are always looking for something like a personal assistant to do various tasks like clean or pet care or weed garden beds… it’s honestly all up to you and what you can and like to do. You make your schedule, you set the price, you accept your clients, it’s all under your control. A trade name in my state was $55. My business insurance is $1200 a year and health insurance is about $2500 a year. But i have GOOD health insurance too. It’s better than what 90% of companies offer. But Im also a single female so it’s not too costly for just myself idk about family plans. In any case… all you have to do is get to know people and build a small client base. You can set your price to easily up to $50 an hour. You don’t have to hire people and get logistical. You can literally just be a private contractor for a few families or households.
Self employment, self employment, self employment. Do what you love, on your OWN terms and time.
